units: <cite ref="Sukkah 56b">Succ. 56ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 83b">Keth. 83ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>טב מק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00311"><he>בּוּצִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 78a:7">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>מצטנן בק׳</he> cooled his hands with a pumpkin.
<cite ref="Keritot 6a:4">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Horayot 12a:12">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S02019"><he>קָרֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="S02026"><he>קָרַיָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a:5">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ בני זרתא</he> pumpkins of the size of a fist.
Sabb. 129ᵇ מאה ק׳, v. קַרְנָא I; a. e.—קָרַיָּיא וְקָרָוָותָא large and small gourds, all kinds of gourds.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:1:4">Y. Ned. VII, beg. 40ᵇ</cite> (not <he>וכרובתא</he>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:5:4">Y. Orl. III, 63ᵇ</cite> top <he>קירייא וקרותוא</he> (corr. acc.).
